Who We Are
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
 About This Role
 We are seeking an Automated QA Engineer to join our Software & Product Infrastructure team in Bucharest . You will help ensure that products and enterprise services delivered to Vodafone customers meet established business and quality requirements.
This is a hands-on role combining manual testing and test automation . You will manually test new features before automating them and validate functionality against user stories and acceptance criteria before releases, particularly where infrastructure, security or test-data constraints limit automation.
Working closely with the software development team, you will contribute to verification processes, identify defects early in the SDLC and build automated testing solutions covering both UI and API testing .
 What You’ll Do
Perform hands-on manual testing of new features before automating them and validate functionality against user stories and acceptance criteria before releases 
Identify software vulnerabilities and quality issues through rigorous testing 
Design test approaches, test cases and procedures to validate software products 
Review software defects, identify affected areas and communicate findings clearly 
Write and maintain automation code to improve the efficiency and coverage of software testing 
Develop and execute automated UI tests to support a consistent user experience across relevant devices and platforms 
Develop automated tests for API endpoints, validating reliability, security and performance under different conditions 
Develop use cases, functional specifications and UX test cases, applying object-oriented analysis where appropriate 
Troubleshoot software issues and contribute to procedures that prepare software systems for release 
Produce quality testing reports and supporting documentation 
Collaborate with design and development teams to identify and resolve application weaknesses 
Review user stories and functional requirements to establish appropriate testing coverage 
Create and configure test environments where test cases and scenarios can be executed 
Contribute to the creation, implementation and management of QA processes, tools and supporting technologies 
 Who You Are
You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field 
You have at least 3 years of experience in Quality Assurance 
You are comfortable performing hands-on manual testing as a core part of your role alongside test automation 
You have strong programming and automation coding skills in JavaScript, preferably, or Java 
You have hands-on experience with Cypress or Playwright, which is essential for this role 
You have experience working with Cucumber and Postman 
You have a sound understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) 
You have experience working within Agile software development environments 
You understand design quality standards and can apply them during testing 
You bring analytical and problem-solving skills to investigating defects and software quality issues 
You understand user experience considerations relating to data-quality issues 
 Not a perfect fit?
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
 What's In It For You
Hybrid way of working
Medical and dental services
Life and hospitalization insurance
Dedicated employee phone subscription
Take control of your benefits and choose any of the below options: MEAL TICKETS/ PRIVATE PENSION/ VACATION VOUCHERS/ CULTURAL VOUCHERS within the budget 
Special discounts for gyms and retailers
Annual Company Bonus
Loyalty Programme
Ongoing Education – we continuously invest in you to ensure you have everything needed to excel on the job and enhance your skills
You get to work with tried and trusted web-technology
Getting in on the ground floor of a technology changing company
We let you write your own story by planning vacations: go for a trip, experience new things, have fun and enjoy your 23 days off 
Special Paternal Program - 4 months of paid paternity leave
 What Skills You Will Learn
 Through the responsibilities described for this role, you will have opportunities to further develop:
Advanced UI and API test automation techniques 
Practical automation development using JavaScript or Java 
Hands-on expertise with Cypress or Playwright, alongside Cucumber and Postman 
End-to-end quality assurance across manual testing, automation and release validation 
Test-environment configuration and management 
Defect analysis, test reporting and quality-gate practices 
Cross-functional collaboration with software development and design teams 
Quality assurance practices across the wider SDLC and Agile software delivery lifecycle
